rationale: Table4.tex (tables/tables/Table4.tex) reports two subgroup rows matching the claim: row 'm1' (incumbents) shows %ΔW = 0.095*** (0.020) and spillover share = 0.422** (0.181); row 'm2' (new entrants) shows %ΔW = 0.019 (0.013) and spillover share = -0.178 (0.748). All four replicated values equal the paper values exactly: incumbent_wage 0.095 vs 0.095, incumbent_spillover_share 0.422 vs 0.422, new_entrant_wage 0.019 vs 0.019, and new_entrant_spillover_share -0.178 vs -0.178.
